verdict.rationale: Cekura is a voice-agent testing and observability platform that hosts and simulates agents and tools, so it could plausibly connect to MCP servers as a client and the axis applies. The pack only shows Cekura publishing its own MCP server and Skills for AI coding assistants to use (the server role) and non-MCP mock tools. Nothing shows users plugging external MCP servers into Cekura to use their tools.
